title: The Lake
description:
Uses ExGfx slots: FG3, BG2
Uses Pallete Row(s): 2,4

Custom graphics made for the Fourth Sector. This is a lake Foreground; however, it only includes original tiles. The water on the screenshot is ripped from Yoshi's Island, and is therefore not included. This includes slopes, ledges, the usual. But it also incorporates some metal scaffolding as it was made with a rig nearby in mind. Credit would be nice if used.
